component.name: Verdana
component.summary: A launcher for Nostr napps that plug into each other

description.p: Napps are small apps that do one thing and (hopefully) do it well. They can be written in HTML or they can be raw WASM with custom UI rendering.
Because they don't do all the things, they can invoke other napps to do these other things. You install each app individually and plug one into the other during your usage session.

Verdana is a launcher for napps. Besides running the napps and passing messages between them, it also allows you to save shortcuts for specific napps or groups of napps as application shortcuts or in an in-app home screen.
